The '''2020–21 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team''' represented [[West Virginia University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Mountaineers were coached by [[Bob Huggins]], in his 14th season as WVU's head coach, and played their home games at the [[WVU Coliseum]] in [[Morgantown, West Virginia]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 19–10, 11–6 in [[2020–21 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 Play]] to finish in 4th place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2020–21 Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball team|Oklahoma State]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.oklahoman.com/story/sports/2021/03/11/avery-anderson-gives-oklahoma-state-basketball-legit-no-2-scorer/4652609001/|title=Tramel: Oklahoma State basketball has a No. 2 scorer in Avery Anderson. Watch out, Big 12.|work=[[The Oklahoman]]|first=Berry|last=Tramel|date=March 11, 2021|access-date=November 1, 2024}}</ref> They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2020–21 Morehead State Eagles men's basketball team|Morehead State]] in the First Round before losing in the Second Round to [[2020–21 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]].

==Previous season==
The [[2019-20 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|Mountaineers]] finished [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 21–10, 9–9 in Big 12 play to finish tied for third place in the conference. The Mountaineers were to play in the Big 12 Tournament, but it was canceled due to the COVID-19 Pandemic.
